plugins/cross-platform-notification/.cla.summary: Plugin configuration for native system notification functionality in Claude Code.

plugins/documentation/.claude-plugin/plu.summary: Plugin configuration file declaring the documentation skill with metadata and author information.
plugins/documentation/.claude-plugin/plu.purpose: Registers the documentation plugin in the Claude Code ecosystem with version control and author attribution.

plugins/fetch-full-content/.claude-plugi.summary: Plugin configuration declaring fetch-full-content with security warnings and version metadata.

plugins/fetch-full-content/CHANGELOG.md.summary: Documents version history and feature changes for the fetch-full-content plugin from v1.0.0.0 to v1.2.0.0.
plugins/fetch-full-content/CHANGELOG.md.purpose: Tracks all notable changes, security improvements, and bug fixes across releases with semantic versioning details.

plugins/fetch-full-content/README.md.summary: Comprehensive documentation for the fetch-full-content plugin covering features, usage, security, and best practices.

plugins/session-protocol/.claude-plugin/.summary: Plugin manifest for the session-protocol plugin with metadata and hook configuration.

README.md.summary: Comprehensive documentation of Claude Code Toolkit marketplace with plugin descriptions, quick start guide, and feature highlights.

plugins/project-intel/scripts/types.ts.summary: TypeScript type definitions and constants for summaries, query results, and hook responses.
